title: 2027 Investment Internship (London)
content: <p>Verition Fund Management is a multi-strategy, multi-manager hedge fund with offices in New York, London and Hong Kong.</p><h3>About the role</h3><p>Our 2027 Investment Internship in London places students with portfolio management teams for ten weeks. Interns research companies and markets, build models and present investment ideas to senior portfolio managers.</p><h3>Responsibilities</h3><ul><li>Analyse company filings, industry data and market moves</li><li>Build and maintain financial models</li><li>Write up and present a stock pitch at the end of the summer</li></ul><h3>Qualifications</h3><ul><li>Penultimate-year undergraduate in any discipline</li><li>Strong interest in financial markets and investing</li><li>Clear written and spoken communication</li></ul>
